It has previously been agreed to name the JSON data files aligned with the band combination name/acronym. This means e.g. the band combination CA_n1A-n2A would be named as CA_n1A-n2A.json and DC_1A_n2A would be named DC_1A_n2A.json within the database. However, MCC is proposing that instead the Tdoc number is amended after the title (i.e. configuration name) as <combo>_N_R4-26xxxxx.json: for new ones <combo>_M_R4-26xxxxx.json: for modified ones MCC will then remove the 13 characters before .json when including them to the database. When submitting the JSON files it would then with the Tdoc numbers look as shown in the following: JSON files are saved including the TDoc number suffixed the file name and indication of Modified (M) or New (N): or JSON files are saved within the zip file in a sub-folder named “JSON”: If multiple JSON files these are all in the same JSON folder (Note this is not zipped): This means that the Tdoc number is included to the title of the JSON datafiles in all steps of the process from submitting until it is included/merged into the database. Within the database only the band combination name/acronym would be used, i.e. without the Tdoc number and indication of new or modified. WF RAN4 adopts the new file name structure for the JSON data files when submitting them.
